text.tspan: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report
Figure 5.3. Storage equipment annual electricity use by type.
Network electricity also sees rapid growth through 2028, ultimately reaching 23 TWh, as shown
in Figure 5.4. This growth is largely driven by the introduction of InfiniBand switch units, which
account for 45% of the total in 2028, growing from just under 10% in 2023. Note that other
internal network hardware for AI, such as NV links, are considered part the AI server system
and represented within the accelerated server category. 200/400Gb ports also grow rapidly,
from 6% in 2023 to 26% by 2028. Port speeds less than 50Gb see a decline in total energy
usage. In 2023, these speeds accounted for 15% of total energy usage, but in 2028 they fall to
Figure 5.4. Network electricity use by port speed, with InfiniBand switches.
